# One-Pan Vegan Sweet Potato & Chickpea Skillet

A hearty, plant-based dinner designed for minimal cleanup and maximum nutrition, ready in just 45 minutes.

## Recipe Instructions
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/47/Roasted_Sweet_Potato_and_Chickpea_Salad.jpg/1200px-Roasted_Sweet_Potato_and_Chickpea_Salad.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clock.svg
- **Ingredients:** 800g sweet potatoes (1cm cubes), 800g canned chickpeas (drained), 200g fresh spinach, 30ml olive oil, 10g smoked paprika, 5g garlic powder, salt/pepper.
- **Step 1:** Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Add sweet potatoes and cook for 8-10 minutes until edges are browned.
- **Step 2:** Stir in drained chickpeas, paprika, and garlic powder. Transfer skillet to oven at 200°C for 15-20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
- **Step 3:** Return skillet to stovetop over low heat. Toss in fresh spinach and stir for 2 minutes until just wilted. Season with salt and pepper.

## Nutritional Breakdown (Per Serving)

- **Calories:** 410 kcal
- **Protein:** 14g
- **Fiber:** 16g
- **Fat:** 12g
